Electricity Game Sound Pack (one file used: groundhit.wav)

Author: faxcorp
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/electricity-game-sound-pack
File used: groundhit.wav (one of 16 in the pack -- only this file was pulled in)
Downloaded from: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/groundhit.wav

License: CC0 (Creative Commons Zero / public domain), single license for the whole pack
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

No attribution required.

Disclosed tradeoff: no dedicated CC0 "lightning spell" one-shot turned up in this search pass
(OpenGameArt's "Spell Sounds" electricspell.ogg/electricspell2.ogg were disqualified -- that
page states "OGA-BY 3.0 and CC0" as a mixed license across its files, and this project's search
order only accepts assets that are individually, unambiguously CC0, same bar Kenney's own packs
meet). This pack's own flavor is a generic sci-fi electric-game effect, not a fantasy lightning
spell -- picked as the closest available CC0 stand-in for the lightning element's cast cue,
same handling as 3.10's original sci-fi zap stand-ins. Flagged for a future re-source pass if a
better-fitting CC0 lightning spell sound surfaces later.

---

2026-08-11 (issue #111): added groundhit-normalized.wav, a derivative of groundhit.wav above
(Art Sourcing Contract step 3 -- derived from an already-approved CC0 asset, not a new
download). RMS-normalized to -16 dBFS (from -25.68 dBFS whole-clip / measured -17.32 dBFS over
just the actual 0.285s of audible content once you exclude the trailing pad below -- this file
is by far the quietest and spikiest of the 4, so a smooth tanh soft-limiter, not a hard clip,
caps the few loudest transient samples while still allowing the +9.68dB gain the rest of the
signal needed) and length-fit to the shared 1.20s target by appending 0.915s of trailing silence
(the original audible content is unchanged -- 0.285s, same recording -- only a silent tail was
added so the file's scheduled playback duration matches the other 3 elements). This does NOT
fix issue #137 (the recording itself still reads as a generic sci-fi stand-in, not a fantasy
lightning spell) -- only loudness and file-duration were normalized here, per #111's own
out-of-scope note not to touch #137's content problem. Same CC0 license applies to the
derivative. Original file kept alongside, untouched, as provenance. See
docs/agents/tilesmith/log.md's 2026-08-11 entry for the full before/after measurement table.
